subject: sg
title: SG.------HI.P.
description: Diagram in CMBA-4, paired with v1-p248-1. (C)SI (source initiation, conceptually) is crossed with HI-P (high purpose). The diagram poses what source initiation requires of high purpose to actually function — situated against Braxton's claim that black creativity's source-initiation 'completely solidify[ed] its own methodology' through 'natural continuance of affinity dynamics.' SI fans into three primary branches: HI-P (the crossing partner), DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) → COS-P (cosmic particulars), and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and SPT-DY → C-ACT (composite activism). HI-P then branches to INT (intention), EXT-FT (extended functionalism), and BIA (bi-aitional). COS-P also branches to INT, creating a convergence point. Structural argument: source initiation produces high purpose, dynamic spiritualism, and spiritual dynamics as parallel outputs, with intention as a downstream convergence point fed by both high purpose and cosmic particulars. The diagram thus diagrams Braxton's structural claim that source initiation in black creativity is not a single line — it requires high purpose for its 'spiritual overview' (extended functionalism, bi-aitional dual-principle integration), dynamic spiritualism for its cosmic grounding, and spiritual dynamics for its actualization as composite activism. The intention node is where high-purpose-derived intent and cosmic-particular-derived intent converge.
